label: PF Backlog 610
title: pre-commit lint_check crashes in git worktrees (WinError 206 long path) - blocks commits
body: Observed during EDP-01 (BI-PF-1293) in the assignment worktree product-forge-worktrees/assign-bi-pf-1293: the pre-commit hook step `python product-forge/scripts/dev/lint_check.py --strict` fails with FileNotFoundError [WinError 206] The filename or extension is too long (subprocess spawn), so the commit is blocked even for a docs-only change with 0 changed .py files. Running lint_check.py --strict manually from product-forge/ returns OK (exit 0); the crash is specific to the hook running at the worktree root. Precheck PASSES. Workaround used: git commit --no-verify. Needs RCCA: bound/relativize the changed-file path list / run lint from the product-forge dir so the Windows command line stays within limits.

brief.problem: pre-commit lint_check crashes (WinError 206) in a worktree, blocking commits.
brief.what_adds: Bound/relativize the hook's file list (or run lint from product-forge) so it works in worktrees.
brief.why: Workers commit from worktrees; a crashing hook blocks every delivery.

objective: Make the pre-commit lint_check work from a git worktree (no WinError 206 long-path crash).
acceptance_criteria: git commit works in a worktree checkout (including deep paths with spaces) for a docs-only change.
The hook does not pass an over-long argument list; lint still runs on changed .py files.
A regression test or guard reproduces the worktree path case.
